chooser.title: Create
chooser.lead: One shape for everything you create here: you describe it, Oxagen drafts the file, you read it, and a pull request publishes it.
chooser.note: None of these writes a row. Each one ends on a pull request against {repository}, where a reviewer decides whether to merge the files.
chooser.noteUnknown: None of these writes a row. Each one ends on a pull request against the workspace’s main repository, where a reviewer decides whether to merge the files.

tool.label: Tool
tool.body: A capability an agent can be granted. Imported from an MCP server, or built here.

skill.label: Skill
skill.body: A procedure written down: a file, a version and a digest.

record.label: Context record
record.body: One statement that steers every agent it reaches.

source.title: Add a skill
source.subtitle: A skill is a file with a version and a digest. There are three ways to get one, and all three end in a merge.

registry.title: Search the registry
registry.body: Pin a published version by its digest. Review its publisher, instructions, and required tools before adding it.
registry.closed: No skill registry is connected to this workspace yet.

describe.title: Describe it
describe.body: Write what the procedure is, in prose. Oxagen drafts the SKILL.md, and you edit it before anybody reads it.

upload.title: Upload a bundle
upload.body: A .skill, a .zip or a SKILL.md built elsewhere. Use it to replace a pinned version with the one in the bundle.

source.note: No step here writes to a database. Whichever way you come in, the last step is a pull request against the workspace’s main repository.

describe.title: Describe the skill
describe.subtitle: Procedure, not policy: what to do, in what order, and the one thing never to do.
describe.placeholder: How we cut release notes: group merged PRs by surface, read the changelog once, open a PR, and never publish the release.
describe.hint: A skill tells an agent what to do. That is why this ends in a pull request, not a save.

suggestions.rollback: How to roll a bad release back
suggestions.migration: How to run a safe Postgres migration
suggestions.flakyTest: How to triage a flaky test

describe.noAuthority: Do not write authority into it. “You may merge” in a skill grants nothing: the toolbelt decides, and a skill that implies otherwise will be wrong in a run somebody has to read.

upload.title: Upload a bundle
upload.subtitle: The bundle is read and hashed in this tab. Nothing is stored until the pull request merges.
upload.label: Bundle
upload.nothing: Nothing chosen yet. The bundle is read in this browser tab and sent nowhere until the pull request carries it.
upload.replaces: The skill’s name comes from the bundle’s frontmatter. If that skill is already merged, the pull request replaces it, and the version in the bundle must be greater than the merged one. The old version stays readable: every run that loaded it named its digest.

error.wrong_type: A skill bundle is a .skill, a .zip or a bare SKILL.md.
error.too_large: The bundle is larger than a skill may be: 64 KB a file, 2 MB an archive.
error.not_a_zip: This file is not a zip archive Oxagen can read.
error.unsupported_method: The archive uses a compression method other than stored or deflate. Zip it again and retry.
error.binary_file: The bundle holds a binary file. A skill bundle carries text only.
error.too_many_files: The bundle holds more than 16 files beside SKILL.md.

draft.precondition: Say what has to be true before the first step. A procedure that assumes a state nobody checked is how an agent does the right thing at the wrong moment.
draft.never: Name the one thing never to do here, and why.
draft.grantsNothing: This file grants nothing. Every action it names still goes through the toolbelt and the policy that governs it.

review.title: The file
review.subtitle: This is the whole of it. A skill has no code to run and no credential to hold.

drafted.title: A SKILL.md, drafted from what you wrote
drafted.body: Oxagen filled a template in from your description, in this tab. No model wrote it and no run was recorded. Every line below is yours to change before anybody reviews it.

review.cost: Every token in this file is paid for on every turn it is loaded into, by every agent that loads it. The estimate is four characters a token. The model’s tokenizer has the real count.
review.invalidName: Set the frontmatter name to a lowercase name with hyphens, up to 48 characters.
review.invalidFrontmatter: Fix the skill frontmatter. Name, semantic version, and scope are required. Duplicate keys, aliases, merge keys, and permission grants are not supported.

pr.title: Open the pull request
pr.subtitle: A skill an agent can find is a skill somebody merged.
pr.lead: Merging this makes {name} resolvable in {workspace}. The digest covers the submitted bytes. Review later pushes before merging.
pr.replaces: If this skill is already merged, the pull request replaces it, and the checks refuse a version that is not greater than the merged one. Runs in flight keep the version they resolved.

frontmatter.name: Frontmatter
frontmatter.detail: name, version and scope are present, and the name matches the directory

version.name: Version
version.detail: major.minor.patch, and greater than the version it replaces

digest.name: Digest
digest.detail: computed over the submitted canonical bytes; later pushes need a new review

grants.name: Grants
grants.detail: the file names no authority: a skill cannot raise a tier or add a tool

secrets.name: Secret and PII scan
secrets.detail: the body and every bundle file are scanned, and a literal credential fails the check

loadCost.name: Load cost
loadCost.detail: inside the search budget .oxagen/skills.toml names, or 6,000 tokens when it names none

repo.unbound: This workspace has no main repository yet. Bind one in Workspace settings, then open the pull request.
repo.denied: Opening a skill pull request needs Owner or Admin on the organization.
repo.unavailable: The main repository could not be read ({code}). Nothing was written. Close the wizard and open it again to retry.

opened.title: Pull request opened
opened.subtitle: The skill exists when somebody merges it.
opened.added: {name} {version} is proposed. It resolves when the pull request merges.
opened.replaced: {name} {from} to {version} is proposed. Each agent picks it up at the next run it starts, never in one already in flight.
opened.tokens: About {tokens, number} tokens to load, inside the {budget, number}-token search budget.

failure.checkFrontmatter: The frontmatter check failed: name, version and scope must be present, and the name must match the directory. Nothing was written.
failure.checkVersion: The version check failed: the version must be major.minor.patch and greater than the merged one. Nothing was written.
failure.checkDigest: The digest check failed: the file is not text. Nothing was written.
failure.checkGrants: The grants check failed: the frontmatter names authority, such as allowed-tools. Remove it, since the toolbelt decides. Nothing was written.
failure.checkSecrets: The secret scan found a credential or personal data. Remove it and try again. Nothing was written.
failure.checkLoadCost: The file is over the workspace’s search budget. Cut it and try again. Nothing was written.
failure.mergedUnversioned: The merged copy of this skill has no version, so there is nothing to compare against. Fix it on the production branch first.
failure.orgRoleRequired: Opening a skill pull request needs Owner or Admin on the organization.
failure.noRepository: This workspace has no main repository yet. Bind one in Workspace settings.
failure.githubRefused: GitHub refused the write. Check the GitHub App’s access to the repository and try again.
failure.gitlabRefused: GitLab refused the write. Nothing was published. Check that the project access token still has the api scope and the Developer role, then try again.
failure.gitlabCredentialRejected: GitLab no longer accepts the project access token stored for this project. Nothing was changed. Connect the project again with a new token.
failure.unanswered: Oxagen did not answer. Nothing was written. Try again.
failure.refused: The pull request was refused ({code}). Nothing was written.
failure.invalid: The {field} value is not one propose_skill accepts. Nothing was written.
failure.pendingApproval: Opening this pull request waits for approval: access request {request}.

clone.title: Clone configuration
clone.lead: Review a copy under a new name. This opens a proposal and leaves the original in place. It copies no credentials or access grants.
clone.label: Label
clone.companions: Includes {count} companion files from the source.
clone.done: Proposed {name}. Merge and publish it before using the new configuration.
clone.denied: Your organization role must be Owner or Admin to clone this configuration.
clone.unavailable: The published configuration could not be read. Retry after checking the repository binding.
clone.collision: Another configuration already holds this slug or name. Choose another, or reopen the draft for the next suggestion.
clone.changed: The source changed after this draft opened. Close and reopen the draft before submitting.
clone.refused: The clone did not pass validation. Check the source and submit again.

loadFailed.title: The form did not load
loadFailed.body: Oxagen could not read this wizard. Nothing was written. This usually means the page has been open since before a release.
